notes: Identical 24-case corpus, compiled pack bytes, device, OS and debug mode. Each run checks full ParseResult equality with cache 0; result signatures match caches 0/256. Current normal and phase-mode signatures also match.

Fresh app processes, 50 warm-up rounds and 300 samples per locale. File-system page cache, ART/JIT state, temperature and background load were not controlled. Two baseline batches show variation; these observations do not establish stable improvements.

Normal firstParseNs includes lazy pack mapping/header and parsing, excludes engine registration/setup. Diagnostic mode measures setup, mapping, standalone header, lazy parse using mapped storage and formatting in a separate process; its normal metric firstParseNs is already warm. Do not sum phases or compare that firstParseNs with normal cold runs.

Memory is observed instrumentation-process PSS/heap/RSS and includes temporary results, workspace and GC; not isolated retained dictionary memory. iOS has compile/publication validation, not runtime measurements.
